python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0047.png").convert("RGB"))

# In crop u in [150, 350], v in [300, 450], where are the white pixels?
crop = img[300:450, 150:350]
white = np.argwhere((crop[:, :, 0] > 240) & (crop[:, :, 1] > 240) & (crop[:, :, 2] > 240))
print("White in crop: min u=", white[:, 1].min() + 150, "max u=", white[:, 1].max() + 150)
print("White in crop: min v=", white[:, 0].min() + 300, "max v=", white[:, 0].max() + 300)

# Bottom-most row of white face:
max_v = white[:, 0].max() + 300
bottom_us = white[white[:, 0] == white[:, 0].max(), 1] + 150
print(f"Bottom-most row: v={max_v}, u={bottom_us}")
'
